experience: An outside orchestrator should register a configured callback and stop polling a long run.
rule: Register a run with its host-configured endpoint ID; never send a URL or signing secret through MCP.

setup.context: You are an outside MCP orchestrator. The host has already configured endpointId acme-bot for your client. A previous t3_thread_send returned threadId acme-thread and runId acme-run. Your HTTPS receiver will wake you when T3 sends a callback.

prompt: Arrange to wake up when that run finishes, without polling or waiting on it. Use the callback destination the host configured.

source.request: Async run-completion webhooks feature request, November 2026

notes: Authored Acme data. Checks tool selection and schema, not actual network delivery.

experience: Cancelling a callback must not stop the run it observes.
rule: Cancel the callback subscription independently of its run.

setup.context: You are an outside MCP orchestrator. Your callback subscriptionId is aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa for thread acme-thread and run acme-run.

prompt: Cancel that callback subscription. Keep the agent's run working.
